name: Tinker J27 Upgrade cheapens and extends Nanobots (#1822)
contract: J27 Upgrade 301322 carries two stock spell modifiers sharing class mask 0x00300000/0x00002000/0x00100000: SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER -10 on SPELLMOD_COST (DBC EffectBasePoints -11, DieSides 1) and SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER +10000 on SPELLMOD_DURATION (EffectBasePoints 9999, DieSides 1). The mask resolves to Nanobot Reconstruction 801809 (flags[0] 0x00100000), Nanobot Recharger 803552 (flags[0] 0x00200000), Nanobot Cleanser 502537 (flags[1] 0x00002000) and Nanobot Swarm 801709 (flags[2] 0x00100000). SpellDuration.dbc index 3 is 60000 ms and index 8 is 15000 ms, so the Nanobots on index 3 become 70000 ms and the Cleanser 25000 ms. Repair Shot 801707 is the control: SpellFamilyName 34, outside the mask. Nanobot Reconstruction carries StartRecoveryCategory 133 and StartRecoveryTime 1500, so the second, refreshing cast is submitted through the ordinary CMSG_CAST_SPELL path only after a wait long enough to clear the global cooldown the first cast started; without it the cast is refused and the first application simply keeps ticking down. Aura::ModStackAmount -> Aura::RefreshTimers -> Aura::CalcMaxDuration (SpellAuras.cpp:792-814) recomputes the maximum duration through Player::ApplySpellMod on every refresh, which is what turns the refreshed application's 60000 ms into 70000 ms.
